purpose: Cross-check the Cagayan basin candidate Glossogobius biorbitalis against the current Catalog of Fishes entry and record its reported type locality without converting a text locality to coordinates.

candidate.globalDatasetRole: Basin-level discovery candidate; numeric bibliography referenceIds are not a citation-to-basin crosswalk.

taxonomicSourceCrosswalk.source: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes, online version updated August 2026
taxonomicSourceCrosswalk.originalDescriptionReference: Endruweit, M. 2024. Fishes of the Red River - Perciformes, Synbranchiformes. Endruweit, Isernhagen: 1-282. Catalog reference 41040.

catalogReportedTreatment.typeLocality: Bua River, Cagayan River drainage, Dupax Del Norte County, Nueva Vizcaya Province, Luzon Island, Philippines
catalogReportedTreatment.paratypes: PNM and SEAFDEC; catalog excerpt gives no lot numbers

taxonomicSourceCrosswalk.retrievalLimit: The official Catalog of Fishes search index returned the species and reference excerpt. Direct page retrieval returned HTTP 403 during this review; the original 2024 book and specimen labels were not directly inspected.

localityResolution.reportedDrainage: Cagayan River drainage; upper Cagayan River drainage
localityResolution.administrativeText: Dupax Del Norte, Nueva Vizcaya, Luzon
localityResolution.basinCrosswalk: The Catalog explicitly names the Cagayan River drainage, textually linking the reported type locality to the same drainage-basin system as B0380. No coordinates were available for a point-in-polygon overlay.
localityResolution.evidenceClass: Historical type-locality reported by a current taxonomic catalog; not a dated event record with a reviewed specimen label or coordinate.

gbifCrossCheck.result: The bounded coordinate search produced a higher-rank match only for the exact candidate name; no species-rank coordinate row was used.
gbifCrossCheck.interpretation: The GBIF result is a scoped indexing outcome. It does not contradict the Catalog's type-locality report and does not establish absence.

interpretation: A current taxonomic catalog reports a type locality for G. biorbitalis at Bua River in the Cagayan drainage, making this a stronger Cagayan-specific lead than a name-only basin candidate.
The evidence is traceable to the Catalog's citation of the Endruweit 2024 book, but the book and PNM/SEAFDEC specimen labels were not reviewed directly.

The locality supports a historical taxonomic type-locality association only; it does not establish current presence, abundance, distribution throughout B0380, catchability, legal status, or fishing safety.
Do not map the catalog locality as a point or exact reach without coordinates and a separate Bua River geometry crosswalk.

sources.supports: Indexed Catalog of Fishes entry for Glossogobius biorbitalis: accepted status, Endruweit 2024 citation, Bua River type locality, and holotype PNM 15688.
